subject.title: feat(sessions): grouping, unread state, and full session controls on web, iOS, and Android

question: After the Android blockers and merge conflicts are fixed, should this cross-client session-manager rollout land as one integrated gateway/web/iOS/Android PR, or be split into staged gateway and client PRs?
rationale: The PR adds new gateway protocol parameters, persistent read/unread session state, and destructive session controls across three clients under a protected maintainer label, so final acceptance needs maintainer product/API intent beyond code repair.

options.title: Fix And Continue This PR
options.body: Keep the integrated PR as the landing vehicle after the Android state bugs, conflict refresh, and upgrade proof are addressed.

options.title: Stage Gateway First
options.body: Split unread/fork protocol and session-store semantics into a smaller gateway PR, then land web, iOS, and Android controls separately.

options.title: Pause Direction
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the linked feature issue open until maintainers settle the permanent session-manager contract.

recommendation.title: Fix And Continue This PR
recommendation.body: Keep the integrated PR as the landing vehicle after the Android state bugs, conflict refresh, and upgrade proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the linked feature proposal and has recent current-main work on the session creation and Android chat/session surfaces affected here.
